name: Cushi
title: The Messenger to King David
summary: Cushi was a messenger sent by the commander Joab to bring King David the news of victory over Absalom's rebellion and of Absalom's death. He is best known from the account in 2 Samuel 18, where he runs alongside Ahimaaz to deliver the king the report on the outcome of the battle.

keyEvents.title: Joab Sends Cushi as a Messenger
keyEvents.description: After Absalom's rebellion was crushed and Absalom was killed, Joab sent Cushi to bring the news to King David.

keyEvents.title: Cushi Bows to Joab's Command
keyEvents.description: Cushi obeyed Joab's order and ran to deliver David the message of victory, even though the message also carried the painful news of Absalom's death.

keyEvents.title: Ahimaaz Runs Past Cushi
keyEvents.description: Ahimaas, who also wished to bring the news, was finally given permission by Joab and took a different route, so that he arrived before Cushi.

keyEvents.title: Cushi Arrives with the Message
keyEvents.description: When Cushi arrived, he told David that the Lord had vindicated him against all who rose up against him, thus delivering the message of victory.

keyEvents.title: Cushi Reveals Absalom's Death
keyEvents.description: When David asked whether it was well with the young man Absalom, Cushi indirectly answered that Absalom was dead by wishing that all the king's enemies might meet the same fate as the young man. This triggered deep grief in David.
